keys: A sailor aboard the ship is offering bounty contracts to clear rattos from the ship's hold.
en: A sailor aboard the ship is offering bounty contracts to clear rattos from the ship's hold.
zh: 船上的一名水手正在发布悬赏任务，清剿货舱里的鼠辈。

keys: Deep in the Sandstorm Mines, you discovered a living Mana Tree and recovered its Kano, a rare Mana Seed.
en: Deep in the Sandstorm Mines, you discovered a living Mana Tree and recovered its Kano, a rare Mana Seed.
zh: 在沙暴矿坑深处，你发现了一棵活着的魔力树，并取回了它的卡诺——一颗稀有的魔力种子。

keys: Elanore needs ingredients to brew healing potions. Bring her six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya.
en: Elanore needs ingredients to brew healing potions. Bring her six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya.
zh: 伊兰诺需要材料调配治疗药水。给她带六份蛆虫黏液、一瓶水和一个火龙果。

keys: Eridu the glassmaker makes very useful glass bottles. He will exchange some bottles for salt, bones and sulphur powder gathered in the desert.
en: Eridu the glassmaker makes very useful glass bottles. He will exchange some bottles for salt, bones and sulphur powder gathered in the desert.
zh: 玻璃匠伊利杜制作非常实用的玻璃瓶。他愿意用在沙漠里收集的盐、骨头和硫磺粉来换瓶子。

keys: For those who once walked these lands before the world was reborn.
en: For those who once walked these lands before the world was reborn.
zh: 献给在世界重生之前踏过这片土地的人。

keys: Found a Chest in the Outskirts
en: Found a Chest in the Outskirts
zh: 在郊外发现了一个宝箱

keys: Found a chest in the Tulimshar eastern outskirts.
en: Found a chest in the Tulimshar eastern outskirts.
zh: 在图利姆沙尔东郊发现了一个宝箱。

keys: Frost, a man sitting on a bench in Tulimshar, asks you to retrieve old letters from the castle corridor. Stay in the shadows to avoid the guards.
en: Frost, a man sitting on a bench in Tulimshar, asks you to retrieve old letters from the castle corridor. Stay in the shadows to avoid the guards.
zh: 弗罗斯特，一个坐在图利姆沙尔长椅上的男人，请你从城堡走廊取回旧信件。躲在阴影里避开卫兵。

keys: Get settled in Tulimshar with Elanore's help.
en: Get settled in Tulimshar with Elanore's help.
zh: 在伊兰诺的帮助下在图利姆沙尔安顿下来。

keys: Investigate a hidden bedroom deep within the Snake Pit, uncover the fate of a Tulimshar thief, solve his riddle, and recover the treasure he never reclaimed.
en: Investigate a hidden bedroom deep within the Snake Pit, uncover the fate of a Tulimshar thief, solve his riddle, and recover the treasure he never reclaimed.
zh: 调查蛇坑深处的一间密室卧房，揭开一名图利姆沙尔盗贼的命运，解开他的谜题，取回他从未赎回的宝藏。

keys: Maggot Slime x6, Water x1, Pitaya x1
en: Maggot Slime x6, Water x1, Pitaya x1

keys: Naem, one of the workers in the Sandstorm Mines, offered you a spare mining helmet to keep you safe as you venture deeper.
en: Naem, one of the workers in the Sandstorm Mines, offered you a spare mining helmet to keep you safe as you venture deeper.
zh: 纳伊姆，沙暴矿坑的一名工人，送你一顶备用矿工头盔，保你深入矿洞时平安。

keys: Nathan is stationed outside the Sandstorm Mines and suffering under the blazing heat. He doesn't need water to drink, just a bottle to pour over himself.
en: Nathan is stationed outside the Sandstorm Mines and suffering under the blazing heat. He doesn't need water to drink, just a bottle to pour over himself.
zh: 内森驻守在沙暴矿坑外，正被烈日炙烤。他不是要喝水，而是要一瓶水浇在身上降温。

keys: Nina is hungry but too dedicated to leave her post. Find her a croissant from the market.
en: Nina is hungry but too dedicated to leave her post. Find her a croissant from the market.
zh: 妮娜饿了，但忠于职守的她不肯离开岗位。去市场给她找个羊角包。

keys: Riskim the baker is waiting for a grain shipment marked with a blue Artis seal. Check the barrels at the docks.
en: Riskim the baker is waiting for a grain shipment marked with a blue Artis seal. Check the barrels at the docks.
zh: 面包师里斯金在等一批带阿蒂斯蓝色蜡封的谷物货。去码头检查那些桶。

keys: Salt x12, Bone x12, Sulphur Powder x12
en: Salt x12, Bone x12, Sulphur Powder x12

keys: Scout the Sandstorm Mines and ensure the cave system is clear of major dangers before the miners move in.
en: Scout the Sandstorm Mines and ensure the cave system is clear of major dangers before the miners move in.
zh: 在矿工进驻之前，勘察沙暴矿坑，确保洞穴系统没有重大危险。

keys: When the desert gives you sand...
en: When the desert gives you sand...
